notes.title: Captain Dodger x Neoblazer FREE UPDATE
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="yrE5HbYyJps;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We're happy to announce a new [b]Captain Dodger X Neoblazer[/b] collaboration. You'll find a new character [i]Drax Gorbuloid [/i]inside the Porkotyler map.[/p][p][/p][p]In a universe ruled by ruthless megacorporations, Drax Gorbuloid is just a sewer worker with no future—until one bad decision lands him in the middle of an underground rebellion. Labeled a "Neoblazer," Drax must choose between the safety of submission and the chaos of freedom. Darkly funny and sharply relevant, Neoblazer is a sci-fi satire about corporate dystopia, lost humanity, and the spark that starts a revolution.[/p]

notes.title: Captain Dodger: Drowned Realm FREE UPDATE
notes.content:
[i]Welcome to the Drowned Realm! Here you will find a new adventure but also some old enemies waiting for you. Assume the form of a merman and vanquish those evil spirits![/i]

[b]Added game features include:[/b]

• New levels
• New characters
• Improved graphics
• Full controller support
• Steam achievements

We'd like to thank you for your continued support. We took all your comments seriously and worked hard to fix the game's issues. It is our belief that if you liked the game before, you're going to love it now. Stay tuned because we'll be adding even more stuff as time progresses. We think Captain Dodger is more than a simple roguelike. It has a real story to tell and we intent to keep exploring it wherever it leads.
